newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Sept aluminium output, shipments rise.
newsitem.headline: Japan Sept aluminium output, shipments rise.

text.p: Japanese output and shipments of fabricated aluminium products both grew strongly in September, reaching record levels for that month, the Japan Aluminum Federation said on Monday.
Totals for the first half of the fiscal year also hit record highs, reflecting a surge in demand for canned beer and aluminium window sashes for new homes, the association said.
September shipments of aluminium mill products were up 6.6 percent from the same month last year at 208,895 tonnes, the sixth consecutive month of year-on-year gains.
Shipments of flat-rolled products rose 2.4 percent to 99,907 tonnes while extruded product shipments were up 10.7 percent at 108,988 tonnes.

September output of fabricated products rose 9.3 percent year-on-year to 215,781 tonnes, reflecting a 9.1 percent increase in flat-rolled output to 106,517 tonnes and 9.5 percent growth in extruded output to 109,264 tonnes.

For the half-year through September, total shipments were up 4.7 percent from the year-ago period at a record 1,258,928 tonnes. Flat-rolled product shipments were up 2.5 percent at 638,716 tonnes and extruded shipments rose 7.0 percent to 620,212 tonnes.

Output in the half-year was up 4.3 percent at 1,260,320 tonnes from the year-ago period, with flat-rolled products up 2.0 percent at 639,343 tonnes and extruded products up 6.8 percent at 620,977 tonnes.
